fullPassage: The mind has parts that are known as the conscious mind and the subconscious mind. The subconscious mind is very fast to act and doesn't deal with emotions. It deals with memories of your responses to life, your memories and recognition. However, the conscious mind is the one that you have more control over. You think. You can choose whether to carry on a thought or to add emotion to it and this is the part of your mind that lets you down frequently because— fueled by emotions— you make the wrong decisions time and time again. When your judgment is clouded by emotions, this puts in biases and all kinds of other negativities that hold you back. Scared of spiders? Scared of the dark? There are reasons for all of these fears, but they originate in the conscious mind. They only become real fears when the subconscious mind records your reactions.

❌ ① physically lowers you to the ground(물리적으로 바닥에 내려놓다): let down의 관용적 의미가 아님
✅ ② disappoints you by causing poor choices(잘못된 선택을 하게 만들어 실망시키다): 'let you down'은 '~을 실망시키다'라는 관용 표현. 감정에 북받쳐 잘못된 결정을 내리게 해 실망시킨다는 의미 ← 정답
❌ ③ helps you relax after a long day(하루 뒤 쉬게 돕다): 실망과 반대
❌ ④ turns down the volume of your thoughts(생각의 음량을 낮추다): let down의 의미가 아님
det.tip: let ~ down = ~을 실망시키다 (관용 표현)

questions.passage: The mind has parts that are known as the conscious mind and the subconscious mind. The subconscious mind is very fast to act and doesn't deal with emotions. It deals with memories of your responses to life, your memories and recognition. However, the conscious mind is the one that you have more control over. You think. You can choose whether to carry on a thought or to add emotion to it and this is the part of your mind that lets you down frequently because— fueled by emotions— you make the wrong decisions time and time again. When your judgment is clouded by emotions, this puts in biases and all kinds of other negativities that hold you back. Scared of spiders? Scared of the dark? There are reasons for all of these fears, but <u>they</u> originate in the conscious mind. They only become real fears when the subconscious mind records your reactions.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 they가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① they는 앞의 these fears(이러한 두려움들)를 가리킴
det.analysis:
✅ ① 두려움들(these fears): 'There are reasons for all of these fears, but they originate in the conscious mind'에서 they는 바로 앞의 these fears(이러한 두려움들)를 가리킴 ← 정답
❌ ② 의식적 마음: they가 비롯되는 '장소'이지 they 자체가 아님
❌ ③ 잠재의식적 마음: they의 지칭 대상이 아님
❌ ④ 편견들: biases는 다른 문장의 내용
det.tip: these fears ... they originate → they = these fears(두려움들)
